paite: Huchi in gitlouhna tengteng, khemna tengteng, lepchiahna tengteng, hazatna tengteng, gensiatna tengteng tawpsan unla,
naungek suak thakte bang in khalam nawitui, bangmah hel louh lunggulh un; huai a na khantheihna ding un:
Toupa mihehpih theitak ahi chih na chep tak ngal uleh.
Amah suang hing, mihingte deih louh, Pathian theih a bel tel leh manpha ahi.
heading: Suang Hing Leh Nam Siangthou

paite: Amah kiang a hong pai in, noute ngei leng suang hingte bang in Jesu Khrist ziak a Pathian kipah lam kithoihna lan ding a siampu siangthou hi ding in khalam inn ah leptouh in na om uhi.
Huaiziak in Laisiangthou ah: "Ngai un, Zion ah aning a suang kiphamohpen tel a om leh manphatak ka lem hi; amah gingtate azahlak kei ding uh," chih atuang hi.
Nou agingtate a ding in huai manphapi ahi, agingtaloute a ding in bel; "Inn lamte suang deih louhpen, huai mah aning a suang phatuampen ahong hita hi."
Huan "Pukna suang leh dalna suangpi ahi. Thu kigente azuih louh ziak un akisuipuk ua; huchibang ding a sehsa ahi him uhi."
Himahleh mial a kipan pawt a, vak lamdangtak a lut ding a nou hon sampa hoihna na muhsak theihna ding un, nou zaw chitel, kumpi siampu, nam siangthou, Pathian mite na hi uhi;
Nidanglai in nam himhim na hi kei ua; tu in zaw Pathian namte na hita uh; nidanglai in zahngaihna na mu kei ua, tu in zaw zahngaihna na muta uhi.
Deihtakte aw, mikhual leh khualzin na hih ziak un kha dou nakpa taksa utnate tawpsan ding in nou ka hon ngen hi.
heading: Pathian Sikhate Thunuailutna

paite: Zentelte lak a na tatdan uh kilawmtak hi hen, huchi in thil hihkhial a, ahon gensiat chiang un leng na thil hoih hih amuhte uh ziak in veh a a-om chiang un Pathian apahtawi thei ding uhi.
Toupa ziak in mihing dan bawl peuhmah ah lut un; thuneihna tawi kumpipa kiang ah hiam,
thil hihkhialte tung a thuk ding leh thil hoih hihte phat ding a kumpipa'n aseh gam ukpate thunuai ah lut un.
Hiai Pathian deihlam ahi, mihaite haina thil hoih hih in na hihdai thei ding uhi.
Noplen na hi ua, himahleh na noplenna uh khelhna khuhna ding a zang lou in Pathian sikha a omna ding in zang zaw un.
Mi tengteng zahtak un. Ki-unauna it un. Pathian laudan siam un. Kumpipa pahtawi un.
Sikhate aw, mihoih leh minunnemte lak kia hilou in migiloute lak ah leng laudan siam in nou hon heute thuthu in om un.
heading: Sikhate'n Khrist Etton Ding

paite: Mi'n Pathian theihna ziak in thuak louh ding thuak a lungkhamna athuak teiteileh huai pen Pathian pahtak lam ahi.

Nou na thilhihkhelh ziak ua vuak na thuak un, kuhkaltak in thuak mah le uchin phatna bang na loh ua? Himahleh na thil hoih hih ziak ua na thuak ua, kuhkaltak a na thuak teitei ualeh, hiai pen Pathian kipah lam ahi.
Khrist in leng nou ahon thuaksak ziak in, huai bang hih ding a sap na hi uhi; akhap a na zuihna ding un zuih ding ahon nutsiat ahi.
"Ama'n thil ahihkhial kei a, akam ah khemna leng a-om sam kei."
Enghou a a-om lai in, a-enghou thuk kei a, athuak lai in avau kei hi; diktattak a ngaihtuahpa kiang ah akipe zaw hi.
Khelhna lam a si khin, adiktatna lam a i hintheihna ding in amah mah in tua sing ah asa in i khelhnate apua hi; avuakna golhte ah hihdam in na omta uhi.
Belam mang bang in na mang ua, tu'n zaw nou hon chingpa leh heutupa kiang ah na kik nawnta uhi.
